name: Scale Faster: Systems, Collaboration and Structured Borrowing
desc: Scale by building less from scratch. Three levers: systems thinking (find the one constraint in the loop and fix only that), collaboration (keep only the work only you can do; written handoffs, one shared source of truth, a 15-minute weekly review) and structured borrowing (borrow the structure of a proven pattern, adapt, test small, keep or drop). One rule: change one thing at a time, measure it, write down what you learned. Includes a 30-day plan, five safety guardrails and a monthly checklist.
